This petition seeking quash of Preliminary Notification dated 04.01.2007 issued under Section 17(1)
of the Karnataka Urban Development Authorities Act, 1987 to the extent of land of the petitioners at Sy.No.53/18(New) Sy.No.53/3(old) measuring 36 guntas situated at Halalu Village, Kasaba Hobli,
Mysuru Taluk and District of the said notification.

2. It is the case of the petitioners that they are the owners in possession of land measuring 36 guntas in Sy.No.53/18(New) Sy.No.53/3(old) situated at Halalu Village, Kasaba Hobli, Mysuru Taluk having inherited the same through their mother.

That respondent No.2 had issued the above Sri Mahadeva S vs State Of Karnataka on 11 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143440933/
2 preliminary notification proposing to acquire lands including belonging to the petitioners for the purpose of formation of Swarna Jayanthi Nagar.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: That though the preliminary notification was issued as far back as 2007 no final notification has been issued till date.
It is NC: 2023:KHC:32813 also contended that neither any award is passed nor the possession is taken nor even the compensation paid.
As such, it is contended that the acquisition proceedings has lapsed.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners relies on Order dated 26.06.2019 passed by a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in W.P.No.47459-461/2018(LA-UDA) by which while allowing the said writ petition the very same preliminary notification dated 04.01.2007 has been quashed to the extent of land belonging to the petitioners therein.
Based on the same it is contended that the petitioners also be extended similar benefit of the order.
4. Heard.
Perused the records.

5. It is not in dispute that except issuing preliminary notification for the purpose as noted above,
there has been no progress in the process of acquisition.
Nothing has been brought on record by the respondent NC: 2023:KHC:32813 authorities regarding they having passed the award or taking possession or paying compensation.

That apart in view of the order dated 26.06.2019 passed in the aforesaid writ petition in W.P.No.47459-461/2018(LA- UDA) in respect of very same notification,
this Court is of the considered view that the present petition requires to be allowed.

Accordingly, following:
ORDER 1. Petition is allowed.
2. Preliminary Notification dated 04.01.2007 is quashed to the extent of the land measuring 36 guntas in Sy.No.53/18(New) Sy.No.53/3(old) situated at Halalu Village, Kasaba Hobli, Mysuru Taluk.
